summary: Top-down roguelite in Godot 4 set in a dark foundry where heat is vision, not ammo: shooting warms you and widens your sight, dashing vents heat and leaves you blind · Karanlık bir dökümhanede geçen Godot 4 roguelite: ısı mermi değil görüş; ateş ettikçe görüşün açılır, dalış ısıyı boşaltır ve seni kör bırakır
key_features: Heat is vision, not ammo: the arena is dark and your sight radius comes from your heat alone, from 40 px cold to 336 px locked
Firing heats the gun; at the ceiling it locks for two seconds and a dash cannot break the lock
Dashing dumps heat and leaves you nearly blind, so safety is paid for with sight
Third-party art and audio credited in KUNYE.md and on an in-game credits screen
